title: ammophila arenaria subsp. arundinacea
intro: Ammophila arenaria subsp. arundinacea, commonly known as Marram Grass, is a perennial plant native to Europe and Western Asia, characterized by its dense and spreading habit. The health benefits of Marram Grass include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antifungal agent, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Marram Grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
